show.description: Preeti sees her husband cheating with her best friend and pretends to lose her memory. To protect himself, her husband lies and says she is married to his billionaire friend, Tarun. While everyone plays a game of lies, Preeti plans her revenge. But as she spends time with Tarun, real emotions begin to grow, changing everything.
